testCase.name: [dev] S06 Generate is blocked exactly when today's pre-round has not been saved cleanly, in both contexts

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B27 · P2 · 新（部分已知）

失败状态提示不对或不清楚：Encounter 页 Generate 灰着但不说原因（已知 U59）；养老院 Save Note 被打断后提示说「文字被改过」；口述自动恢复后红色「断线」错误还挂着；快速口述转写失败时没有「⚠ 该怎么做」

票：TFA-94745 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-10/S29, TC-23/S08, TC-04/S28

思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S06 「正好在今天的查房前没有干净地存好时，Generate 被挡住（两个模式）」 Generate is blocked exactly when today's pre-round has not been saved cleanly, in both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3a Pre-round summary failed: the raw dictation is kept, an error is shown, and Generate stays disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53).（UAT EFS state 3；TFA-94745 state 3；TFA-92588 AC 8 (first sentence)）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given One seeded chart per row: (A) today's pre-round saved but its summary failed (preRoundError set); (B) summary still processing; (C) pre-round text edited after it was last processed; (D) processed cleanly; (E) no pre-round today. Rows A and D also in Nursing Home

When Open each chart's Encounter tab without typing

Then A, B, C: Generate Note & Finish is disabled and the screen says why and to tap Save Note. D: Generate is enabled and no blocking message shows. E: recorded only (Q10)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U3a 'Generate disabled until Save succeeds': rows A and C mustContain 'button "Generate Note & Finish" [disabled]' and 'Save Note'; row D mustContain 'Generate Note & Finish' and mustNotContain the [disabled] form. Row B is judged like A; row E has no expected result (Q10)

在哪跑：dev 单元 U59；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 broken 改成 failed。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92588 ready for pr；TFA-94745 ready for qa

预查房保存在处理中被打断后，Encounter 页的 Generate 变灰，但不说原因也不说该做什么；「点 Save Note 继续」的提示只在 Pre-Round 页出现。

When the pre-round save was interrupted mid-processing, the Encounter tab greys out Generate without saying why or what to do; the 'Tap Save Note to continue' message appears only on the Pre-Round tab.

依据：allure fc7605f3-…-result.json; unit U59 (units/U59.verdict.json), ledger.md #59; s06-hosp-B-processing.md missing "Save Note". Already recorded as dev report §2 #9 (TFA-94745 AC 1/5). Rest tier: the result is 'rest-tier: ticket not ready' because TFA-92588 is at ready for pr, but the defect belongs to TFA-94745 (ready for qa). States A/C/D and NH A/D pass.
